issues.summary: `gh api ... --jq '.html_url' || true` can capture the 404 error JSON body as the release URL
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: At .github/workflows/linear-release.yml:92, gh skips the --jq filter on an HTTP error and writes the raw error body to stdout, so the error JSON would end up in `url=` and be sent to Linear as a link. This only happens on a manual run for a tag that exists but has no GitHub release, which is unusual.

issues.summary: The concurrency group is keyed on raw inputs, so `v1.2.3` and `1.2.3` for the same release land in different groups
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: Line 39 uses `github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.version || github.ref`, while normalization only happens later at lines 70-86. A release event (`v1.2.3`) and a manual `1.2.3` run can therefore sync the same release at the same time. Hitting this needs a manual re-sync during an automated run, and the sync is a repeatable upsert, so the impact is small.

issues.summary: Unversioned manual dispatches are grouped by branch ref rather than by resolved version
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The fallback to `github.ref` at line 39 is deliberate: commit 5506983 says unversioned dispatches should serialize. Calling the group key "less informative" names no concrete failure.

issues.summary: The commit message does not mention the v-prefix mismatch in concurrency groups
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: This is about the commit message text, not code behaviour. The underlying issue is already covered by F2/F5.

issues.summary: The manual run loses the GitHub release link
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: Lines 90-93 look the URL up by tag via `gh api repos/$REPO/releases/tags/$TAG` when the event carries none, and lines 98/120 pass it as `links`.

issues.summary: The manual version input is only checked for emptiness
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: Lines 70-74 strip the `v` and reject anything that does not match `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`, so `1.1220` and `v1.122` fail the run.

issues.summary: dry_run expands to an empty string on the release trigger
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: Line 121 already uses `${{ inputs.dry_run || false }}`, an explicit false fallback.

issues.summary: Vague claim that the workflow_dispatch trigger at line 24 needs justifying
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The header comment at lines 13-14 explains the manual path as the backfill/repair tool. The finding names no concrete problem.

issues.summary: The action's input names were not verified against its action.yml
issues.label: unverifiable
issues.evidence: Lines 117-121 pass access_key/command/version/links/dry_run to an action pinned by SHA, but action.yml is not in the repo and the network is off, so this cannot be settled here.

issues.summary: A manual backfill checks out the branch instead of the release tag
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: Line 107 checks out `refs/tags/${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}`, which is resolved before checkout for both triggers (lines 52-99). A backfill scans that release's history.

issues.summary: The PR body has extra sections beyond Summary and Changes
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: The PR description has only `## Summary` and `## Changes` headings. "Before this works" is bold inline text inside Summary, and there is no "Not verified" section.
